L=/var/lib/bench78402595; CTR="sudo $L/bin/ctr"; DEF=$(cat $L/default_bpf_jit_limit)
REF=docker.io/library/bench78402595-app:1
INIT=$($CTR tasks ls | awk '$1=="tgt" {print $2}')
for pid in $($CTR tasks ps tgt | awk 'NR>1 {print $1}'); do
    [ "$pid" = "$INIT" ] && continue
    [ "$(tr '\0' ' ' 2>/dev/null < /proc/$pid/cmdline)" = "/app hold " ] && sudo kill -KILL "$pid"
done
sleep 1
$CTR tasks exec --exec-id check tgt /app probe
